name: @superschematic/http-runtime
description: Runtime for generated TypeScript API servers: request context, RFC 9457 problem envelope, success envelope, parameter decoding over the superscalar scalar functions, the permission gate, the service-caller verifier and credential sources, a token-bucket rate limiter, the Hono adapter, the readers of the config fields a stack derives, a JSON-lines logger, a pg Pool over a derived database connection and a queue's enqueue and claims (./postgres), a worker's claim loop (./worker), OpenTelemetry trace export on Bun (./telemetry), the provider-neutral Bucket with its GCS implementation (./gcs), the identity runtime of the core user model (./identity), and for Cloudflare Workers the env and bindings of a Worker (./workers), D1's interface as SqlDatabase (./d1), SqlDatabase over bun:sqlite for stack dev (./sqlite) and the Bucket over an R2 binding (./r2), none of which imports from node:. Ships compiled ESM with declarations. Needs superscalar next to it in node_modules; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun test src && bun run build && node scripts/identity-node-check.mjs && node scripts/workers-check.mjs && node scripts/workerd-test.mjs
